text:
Alex K: Handoff — wrapping up my shift. Leaving notes for the planned checkout-service deploy at 2026-03-20 03:00 UTC. Freeze window 02:30-04:00 UTC. Expected risks: brief p95 latency spikes during cache warmup and a small bump in 502s during the first canary. No DB migrations.

Rollout plan (short):
```
canary 5% -> wait 5m -> 20% -> wait 5m -> 60% -> wait 10m -> 100%
healthcheck: GET /health (200 + ready=true)
metric checks: p95 latency, error rate, error budget burn
```

Immediate actions if things go sideways: revert canary -> rollback to v2.7.9 with `deploy-cli rollback checkout-service --to v2.7.9`. Circuit-breaker is enabled; we will auto-failover to previous variant if error-rate > 3% over 2m. Logs to watch: checkout-service/requests, nginx-gateway/5xx, memcached-misses.

Watchers: please ack if you can cover 03:00-03:30 UTC. Pager is me until 02:59, then oncall takes over. DM me if you need context.

Maya R: Ack'd. I can watch 03:00-03:20 UTC — will focus on latency dashboards and gateway 5xx.

Jordan L: Quick question — any cache invalidation on deploy? Last rollout we saw a stampede.

Alex K: No full invalidation this time. We use per-version keys so new nodes warm independently; also added a jittered backoff on fetch. If you see a spike, check memcached-misses and the key prefix `checkout:v2:`.

Sam T: I can be fallback watcher 03:20-03:40 UTC. FYI I bumped the p95 alert threshold by +25% for the rollout window in case of transient spikes.

Oncall Bot: Reminder: scheduled deploy (checkout-service v2.8.0) at 2026-03-20 03:00 UTC. Use `/deploy-checklist` to run prechecks.

Maya R: :thumbsup: all good from my side.

Jordan L: Thanks — will ping if I see anything during the canary.

Alex K: Appreciated. Leaving the channel to you all — reach me if the rollback is needed or for extra context.
